axisReviews.evidence: Elections, referendums and recall mechanisms coexist with concentrated executive control and weakened independent checks.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: He accepted defeat in the 2007 referendum; restrictions on opponents and judicial independence prevent presenting participatory rhetoric as the whole record.

axisReviews.evidence: Speech restrictions, reprisals and weakened courts privilege executive control.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Support for mobilisation and social rights does not eliminate coercive treatment of independent organisations.

axisReviews.evidence: Constitutional recognition of Indigenous peoples and a multiethnic nation favour cultural plurality.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Bolivarian national identity and mobilisation also establish a common civic framework; pluralism is not total priority of separate cultures.

axisReviews.evidence: Regional solidarity and inclusion of migrant residents support comparatively accessible settlement.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Administrative border control and diplomatic conflicts remained; present-day Maduro border restrictions are outside this period.

axisReviews.evidence: Military procurement and confrontational deterrence coexist with regional diplomacy and opposition to US wars.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Anti-US rhetoric is not an unconditional pacifist doctrine; no full autonomous-weapons policy was found.

axisReviews.evidence: National sovereignty and rejection of external interference coexist with ALBA and regional integration.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Regional pooling is real international cooperation; nationalism does not mean opposing every cross-border institution.

axisReviews.evidence: Nationalisations and state-led social missions expand ownership of industry, resources and services.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Private firms continued and the programme evolved after 2005; it was not an immediate abolition of every private enterprise.

axisReviews.evidence: Domestic development and state-controlled strategic sectors constrain ordinary foreign competition.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Oil export dependence, imports and preferential regional trade remain important; exchange controls are distinct from tariffs.

axisReviews.evidence: Price controls, currency restrictions and directed investment establish substantial economic planning.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Private activity and cooperatives remain; policies intensified over the selected period rather than beginning uniformly in 1999.

axisReviews.evidence: Social missions, pensions, public services and land reform aim to transfer resources toward disadvantaged households.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Oil revenue financed much of provision; this does not establish every proposed inheritance or personal wealth tax.

axisReviews.evidence: Civil constitutional law coexists with Christianity in his moral and political rhetoric.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Invoking Christ as a model for socialism is not an institutional clergy veto or a religious family-law system.

axisReviews.evidence: Social and racial inclusion coexist with conventional family norms and limited change on sexual rights.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: A socialist label does not establish support for every present-day progressive sexual-policy position.

axisReviews.evidence: Infrastructure, industrialisation and public health expansion support development.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Environmental rhetoric and safety concerns qualify unconditional technology adoption; biological enhancement remains historically indirect.

axisReviews.evidence: Central executive coordination coexists with communal councils and Indigenous recognition.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: Communal participation sometimes bypassed elected regional opposition, so decentralisation rhetoric does not prove protected regional authority.

axisReviews.evidence: Literacy, social missions and racial inclusion treat education and material conditions as formative.
axisReviews.counterEvidence: These programmes are contextual evidence for social causes, not a quantitative claim about every psychological trait.
